thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: multiple nodes in us-west-2 inference pool are flapping (NotReady + kubelet restarts). Pager P-4782. Automatic mitigation triggered: remove from routing.

maya: ack, taking point. pinging infra. I'm going to gather node state and cordon the affected nodes.

maya: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep infer-node-uw2`
```
NAME                          STATUS     ROLES   AGE   VERSION
infer-node-uw2-17             NotReady   <none>  8d    v1.26.3
infer-node-uw2-29             Ready      <none>  10d   v1.26.3
infer-node-uw2-34             NotReady   <none>  3d    v1.26.3
infer-node-uw2-42             Ready      <none>  2d    v1.26.3
```

infra-sre: seeing repeated kubelet restarts in journal on 17 and 34. Kernel OOM events pointing at nvidia driver/containers. snippet from journal: 
```
Mar 15 10:27:12 infer-node-uw2-17 kubelet[1234]: E0402 kubelet: failed to start container "runtime": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = containerd: containerd: process killed by OOM
Mar 15 10:27:14 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4521 (python) score 987 or sacrifice child
Mar 15 10:27:15 nvidia: GPU watchdog reset
```

chris: seeing p95/p99 spike for text-generation in us-west-2 and ~3% 502 errors in the last 5m. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/infer/usw/request-latency. CS notified, small set of customers impacted.

maya: cordoning infer-node-uw2-17 and infer-node-uw2-34 now and draining pods (ignore daemonsets, delete local data where needed). routing will move to us-west-2-fallback pool.

maya: `kubectl cordon infer-node-uw2-17 && kubectl drain infer-node-uw2-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`

deploy-bot: ran route failover: us-west-2 -> us-west-2-b fallback pool. PR #4123 applied.

tara: I'll try a safe kubelet restart on node 17 (ssh + systemctl restart kubelet) then monitor.

tara: `ssh ubuntu@infer-node-uw2-17 'sudo systemctl restart kubelet && sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 --no-pager'`

tara: kubelet came back up on 17 and node now Ready. marking as drained->rejoin? Holding off on rejoining until we confirm stability.

maya: good, thanks. leaving 17 out of routing for now. 34 is still flapping (kubelet restarts every ~90s).

infra-sre: logs from 34 show repeated CUDA OOMs and GPU driver resets. suspect driver memory leak or work-queue buildup. snippet: 
```
E 10:31:04 cuda-driver: uccol: gpu0: out of memory while allocating 256MiB
W 10:31:04 runtime: container restart backoff
Mar 15 10:31:05 nvidia: GPU reset triggered by watchdog
```

maya: recommend we replace node-34 (evacuate + reprovision) rather than chasing restarts. I'll spin up a replacement node in the dedicated pool (infer-uw2-repl-01).

ravi: taking 10:45-11:45 oncall handoff. I'm on pager. please ping me if anything changes.

maya: handing off. infra, please proceed with reprovision of node-34 when you can. moving any live pods to fallback pool to keep customer-facing traffic healthy. created INC-2026-278 in incidents.

infra-sre: started reprovision workflow for infer-node-uw2-34 -> creating new instance, attaching GPU profile, will cordon and mark old node unschedulable.

deploy-bot: Canary routing change: temporarily reduced batch size and disabled model sharding on fallback pool to reduce GPU mem pressure (policy change id: policy-889).

chris: after failover and drains, error rate dropped to ~0.4% and p99 trending back down. still monitoring. sending update to CS and logged affected tenant IDs to ticket #CS-1219.

maya: customer-alert-bot, please post an external status update: short note about increased errors, mitigation in progress, ETA unknown.

customer-alert-bot: Posted status: "We are investigating increased error rates for inference in us-west-2. Some requests may fail or be delayed. Mitigation is underway; we will update within 30 minutes." link: https://status.redwood/investigations/4782

ravi: I see the new replacement node provisioning is complete. I'll validate drivers and run a short load test before allowing it into pool.

ravi: running `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.total,memory.used --format=csv` on new node; looks clean. starting canary traffic.

ravi: canary results look good for 10 minutes, no OOMs. bringing new node into pool and uncordoning old node-34 after we confirm it's offlined.

infra-sre: decommissioned infer-node-uw2-34 and terminated instance. INFRA ticket INFRA-892 created for postmortem (suspect driver/host-level memory leak).

maya: summary: immediate mitigation = cordon/drain flapping nodes, route traffic to fallback pool, reprovision bad node. customer impact = brief elevated p99 and ~3% 502s for small subset; CS notified. next steps = infra to root cause GPU driver OOM, eng-runtime to add auto-scaling buffer and reduce batch size defaults for us-west-2 temporarily.

ravi: taking over remediation timeline and postmortem. I'll own follow-up, will paste notes into INC-2026-278 and schedule RCA with infra+runtime for driver investigation.

maya: thanks team. handing off to ravi. I'm available if you need me. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Partial mitigation successful. Two nodes replaced, routing restored. Monitoring shows p99 back within SLOs. Next update in 60m or when new info available. :white_check_mark:
